repository.name: RBDtector
repository.description: RBDtector detects phasic, tonic and any events linked to REM sleep behaviour disorder. It closely follows SINBAR and AASM scoring guidelines.

result.title: RBDtector: an open-source software to detect REM sleep without atonia according to visual scoring criteria.
